name: Assured/guaranteed return with risk denial
description: An investment pitch promises assured or guaranteed returns and denies risk — the classic fraud cue that no legitimate regulated product makes.

source_references.quote: It is illegal to act as Investment Adviser without SEBI registration.

explanation.plain: This offer promises guaranteed returns with no risk. No genuine investment can promise that — it is a hallmark of a scam.
explanation.technical: RETURN_GUARANTEE (financial-claim) with risk denial/scarcity/handling funds. RBI FAME and SEBI both present guaranteed-return/zero-risk as fraud cues.
verification_steps: Treat any 'guaranteed' or 'risk-free' return as a scam signal.

provenance.notes: Encoded in the WP3 rule-encoding pass; suppression via negative-indicator-library-v1.json.
